name: Gaomon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Gaogamon] in its name and 1 blue Tamer card among them to your hand. Trash the rest.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have a Tamer in play, return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to its owner's hand.
